newsitem.title: USA: Mobil Torrance, Ca. refinery on fire.
newsitem.headline: Mobil Torrance, Ca. refinery on fire.

text.p: Mobil's Torrance refinery was hit by fire Friday morning with several fire engines battling the blaze, a fire department official told Reuters.
"Petroleum products, of gasoline, are burning," an official at the Torrance fire department said.
He said the fire broke out at 0515 PDT/1215 GMT in one of the units.
The Torrance refinery has a capacity of around 130,000 barrels per day (bpd), with two cracking units, a reformer and a visbreaker.
The fire official said there were no reported injuries but could not estimate when the fire would be put out.
"There are six fire engines there right now, and two additional fire trucks," the official said.
